title: Is BBL Suitable for All Skin Types?
h1: Is BBL suitable for all skin types?
desc: Is BBL laser suitable for all skin types? Why BroadBand Light suits lighter, untanned skin best, the risks for darker skin and the alternatives at Skin & Laser Dubai.
answer: No. BBL works best on lighter to light-olive skin that isn't tanned. Darker skin contains more pigment, which absorbs the light and raises the risk of burns or patches of lighter or darker skin. For darker skin tones, lasers such as Nd:YAG or pico are usually safer choices, and your doctor will recommend one after assessing your skin.
body:
## Why skin tone matters

BBL targets brown pigment and red vessels. When the skin itself contains more pigment, it competes for the light, so less reaches the target and more heat stays in the skin.

## Alternatives for darker skin

- [Pico laser](/treatments/pico-laser-dubai/): low-heat pulses for pigment
- [Laser pigment removal (Q-switch)](/treatments/pigmentation-laser-treatment-dubai/) for individual spots
- [Laser rejuvenation (Nd:YAG)](/treatments/laser-skin-rejuvenation-dubai/) for tone and texture

## Melasma

Melasma can darken with heat-based light. It needs a gentler, combined plan; see [melasma treatment](/melasma-treatment-dubai/).
faq: Can BBL be done on olive skin?
Sometimes, with careful settings and a test spot, if the skin isn't tanned.
What happens if BBL is used on the wrong skin type?
It can cause burns, blisters or lasting changes in skin colour, which is why we assess your skin first.
Is BBL safe for Asian or Middle Eastern skin?
It depends on your individual skin tone and tan; your doctor decides at consultation.
